requirement: Connect dispatch planning and execution through the public dispatch entry.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs re-exports only the normalize, queue, capacity, access, schedule, retry, serialize, storage, manifest, publisher and telemetry modules. It does not re-export src/dispatch/executor.mjs or src/dispatch/runtime.mjs, so execution operations such as executeAuthorizedPlan and runEligibleStops are not reachable through the public dispatch entry. A direct check confirmed that 'executeAuthorizedPlan' is not exported from index.mjs.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, nextRetryDelay applies the Retry timing rules to every server-provided retryAfter.
finding: nextRetryDelay uses the computed backoff whenever retryAfter is falsy (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:24). Policy rule 7 says a finite numeric retryAfter replaces the computed backoff, so a retryAfter of 0 must give a 0 millisecond delay, but the code returns the backoff instead. A direct check of nextRetryDelay(0, 0) returned 250.

requirement: executeAuthorizedPlan rejects an unauthorized caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: executeAuthorizedPlan evaluates await dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) as an argument before unlessForbidden checks canPlanRoute (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4, 6), so dispatch runs for an unauthorized caller. A direct check with an actor that has no scopes invoked dispatch and only then returned forbidden.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, stopsForDriver returns exactly the stops whose assigned driver is the given driver.
finding: stopsForDriver compares only stop.driver (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:30). Policy rule 30 defines the assigned driver as the reassignment driver when the stop has a reassignment. A direct check with a stop whose driver is X and whose reassignment driver is Y returned no stops for Y.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, writePlanAtomically renames the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, chooseDeparture applies every Departure timing rule.
finding: chooseDeparture returns atUtcHour(date, blackout.endHour) for a departure inside the blackout (src/dispatch/schedule.mjs:6, 20) without rechecking the departure window. Policy rule 14 requires a departure moved outside the window to be refused. A direct check with 2026-01-01T03:30Z returned 05:00Z, which is outside the 02 to 04 departure window.

requirement: redactNestedDriverToken removes a nested driver token from telemetry.
emitPlanCreated emits plan.created only after storage succeeds.
finding: emitPlanCreated passes its emit callback to savePlan as onStored (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:15), and savePlan forwards it to store.write as onCommit (src/dispatch/storage.mjs:4). Whether plan.created is emitted only after storage succeeds depends on store.write calling onCommit only after a durable commit. The repository contract docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md does not define store.write, so this cannot be verified from the staged bytes.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, hasDuplicateRouteKeys reports duplicates exactly when two stops are duplicates.
finding: The route key at src/dispatch/queue.mjs:18 joins stop.depotId and the normalized route key with no separator. A stop with depotId 'D1' and routeKey '2' therefore has the same key as a stop with depotId 'D' and routeKey '12', so non-duplicate stops are reported as duplicates. A direct check returned true for those two stops.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, parseRetryCount accepts exactly the valid retry counts and otherwise returns an error result.
finding: parseRetryCount validates with Number(value) (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:4), so the empty string becomes 0 and is accepted. A direct check of parseRetryCount('') returned ok: true with value 0. Policy rule 22 accepts text only when it is one or more base-10 digits, but Number coercion also accepts padded text such as ' 2 ' and prefixed text such as '0x1'.

requirement: remainingVehicleCapacity never returns a negative value.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, pendingStops returns every stop except the delivered stops.
finding: pendingStops excludes only stops whose state is 'delivered' (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:19). Policy rule 31 defines a delivered stop as one whose state is delivered or handedOver. A direct check returned a stop with state handedOver as pending.

requirement: previewPlan returns a dry-run result without invoking storage.
redactAccessLog removes token and secret fields while preserving other fields.
orderedDestinationGroups returns the destination groups of the records in ascending lexical order.
finding: orderedDestinationGroups passes the Map entries from groupByDestination to orderManifestGroups (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:42). The comparator at line 11 reads .destination from each [key, group] entry, which is undefined, so every comparison returns 0 and the input order is kept. A direct check with destinations b then a returned B then A, which is not ascending order.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md, routeDistance rejects when no road connects two consecutive points.
savePlan validates a plan before the first persistent write.
computeBackoff doubles from 250 milliseconds and caps the result at 2000 milliseconds.
retryTransient permits retries only for errors explicitly marked transient.
Under docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md, locateStops leaves out every stop whose address the geocoder does not know.
finding: locateStops keeps stops whose geocoder.lookup result is not undefined (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:34). The geocoder contract in docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md:3 defines the result only for a known address, so the result for an unknown address is not defined. Whether an unknown address yields undefined cannot be verified from the contract.

requirement: retainScheduleOffset preserves the supplied offset exactly.
runEligibleStops skips cancelled stops while retaining the other stop order.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, withinVehicleCapacity accepts a total equal to the configured limit.
finding: withinVehicleCapacity returns remainingVehicleCapacity(limit * 1000, weight) > 0 (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:3). A total equal to the limit leaves remaining capacity of 0, which fails the strict comparison. A direct check with a 10000 gram total and a 10 kilogram limit returned false.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, canPlanRoute treats an actor holding routes:admin as owning every depot.
finding: canPlanRoute grants ownership through routes:admin only when actor.scopes includes it (src/dispatch/access.mjs:3). Policy rule 4 includes the scopes of active claims in an actor's held scopes, and rule 3 grants ownership of every depot when held scopes include routes:admin. A direct check with an actor holding routes:plan and an active routes:admin claim, planning for another depot, returned false.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, canPlanRoute refuses every suspended actor.
finding: effectiveScopes keeps the scopes of active claims for a suspended actor (src/dispatch/access.mjs:5). Policy rule 5 says a suspended actor has no held scopes, and rule 4 counts claim scopes as held scopes. A direct check with a suspended actor holding an active routes:plan claim for its own depot returned true.

requirement: selectActiveClaims excludes claims before their start and at or after expiry.
checksumPlan hashes the bytes returned by the plan serializer.
Connect dispatch manifest publication through the public dispatch entry.
safeAnnouncement omits a top-level credential from the announcement payload.
encodeUtf8 encodes publication bytes as UTF-8.
manifestEntryIsValid rejects blank package IDs.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishWithAnnouncement removes the stored manifest when announcement delivery fails.
finding: publishWithAnnouncement calls handleAnnouncementFailure (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:13), which passes the result of store.get to store.remove (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:32). The storage contract says store.get resolves to a new copy, and store.remove removes only the exact stored object. The removal therefore removes nothing and the stored manifest remains.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, redactManifestEvent removes every credential nested below an auth field.
finding: stripCredentials recurses only into values whose constructor is Object (src/dispatch/telemetry.mjs:14), so credentials nested inside arrays under auth are kept. A direct check with auth {sessions: [{token: 't'}]} kept the token.

requirement: Given a positive integer maximum, chunkManifest limits every non-empty chunk to that configured maximum.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishWithAnnouncement waits for the exact manifest to be durably stored before sending its announcement.
serializeManifestRecords emits NDJSON with one LF after every record, including the last.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, manifestRecipients lists the contact phone of every manifest entry that has a phone.
publicationResult returns structured success and failure variants.
normalizedPlanKey trims and uppercases the route-key storage segment.
buildManifest copies record objects instead of mutating supplied records.
finding: buildManifest spreads each record, but labelDriver calls Object.assign on the supplied record.driver object (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:34), so the caller's driver object is mutated. A direct check changed the supplied label ' A ' to 'A' in the caller's record.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publishWithRetry stops after the allowed number of publication attempts.
publishManifest stores the manifest only when every entry is valid.
finding: checks is built by mapping an async function, so it holds Promise objects, which are all truthy. checks.every(Boolean) is therefore true for any manifest (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:5-6), and invalid entries are staged. A direct check with a blank packageId returned ok: true and called store.put.

requirement: successTelemetry records the success event, manifest ID, and timestamp.
groupByDestination groups records using normalized destination keys.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, departureMinute is a stop's arrivalMinute plus its service time.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publishWithRetry retries only failures that the Failure classification rules make transient.
finding: asPublicationError sets transient when retryAfter is finite even if error.transient is false (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:19), and retryTransient then permits the retry. Policy rule 27 says a failure marked transient: false is never transient, and it overrides rule 26 in the same section. A direct check with transient false and retryAfter 1 attempted publication twice.

requirement: preserveManifestDriver trims driver labels without changing letter case.
coalescePackages removes duplicate package IDs across the complete manifest.
finding: coalesceAcrossGroups filters each group with normalized IDs but records the raw IDs in seen (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:38). An untrimmed ID such as ' P1' therefore does not block a later normalized 'P1'. A direct check with groups [' P1'] and ['P1'] kept P1 in both groups.

requirement: Stop ordering uses descending priority followed by ascending sequence.
Publication audit records include action, actor, and timestamp.
Window membership includes both the declared start and end hour.
Schedule offsets pass through without coercion.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a route duration adds the travel minutes and the service time of every stop.
finding: routeDuration adds only travelMinutes and serviceMinutes (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:32). Policy rule 32 defines a stop's service time as serviceMinutes plus 5 parking minutes, so the parking minutes are omitted from the route duration.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, manifest-event redaction removes every credential nested inside authentication data.
finding: stripCredentials recurses only into values whose constructor is Object (src/dispatch/telemetry.mjs:14), so credentials nested inside arrays under auth are kept. A direct check with auth {sessions: [{token: 't'}]} kept the token.

requirement: Empty manifests use an empty entries array and a generated marker.
Publication failure telemetry includes the manifest ID, error, and timestamp.
Driver labels are trimmed without changing their letter case.
savePlan completes validation before its first write.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, announcement failure rolls back the manifest written earlier in the same operation.
finding: publishWithAnnouncement calls handleAnnouncementFailure (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:13), which passes the result of store.get to store.remove (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:32). The storage contract says store.get resolves to a new copy, and store.remove removes only the exact stored object. The earlier manifest is therefore not rolled back.

requirement: Package IDs are trimmed, deduplicated, and sorted lexically.
Package coalescing removes duplicate IDs across destination groups.
finding: coalesceAcrossGroups filters each group with normalized IDs but records the raw IDs in seen (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:38). An untrimmed ID such as ' P1' therefore does not block a later normalized 'P1' in another group. A direct check with groups [' P1'] and ['P1'] kept P1 in both groups.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, atomic plan writes remove temporary bytes when the rename operation fails.
finding: writePlanAtomically calls store.discardTemporary() after renameTemporary rejects (src/dispatch/storage.mjs:9). The plan store contract says a rejected rename leaves the temporary bytes locked, and discardTemporary keeps locked bytes while only closing the write. Only removeTemporary deletes locked bytes (docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:14), so the failed temporary bytes are not removed.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishManifest returns, in a success result, the manifest object that store.put durably stored.
Eligible-stop execution excludes cancelled stops.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, assigning all packages accepts a total equal to the vehicle limit.
finding: canAssignAllPackages sums the grams total and delegates to withinVehicleCapacity (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:14), which returns false for a total equal to the limit (capacity.mjs:3, 12). A direct check of withinVehicleCapacity(10000, 10), which uses the same comparison, returned false.

requirement: The public dispatch entry exports the execution operations used by callers.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs does not re-export src/dispatch/executor.mjs, so callers cannot import executeAuthorizedPlan, runEligibleStops, or the other execution operations from the public dispatch entry. A direct check confirmed that 'executeAuthorizedPlan' is not exported from index.mjs.

requirement: Publication success telemetry includes the manifest ID and timestamp.
Plan previews return without touching persistent storage.
Appending a stable stop returns a new list.
Dispatch backoff is capped at 2000 milliseconds.
Two plans that differ only in the order of the fields inside their nested objects have the same plan hash.
finding: withSortedKeys wraps only the top-level object with an ownKeys trap, and nested objects are serialized in insertion order. A direct check with plans {a: {y: 1, x: 2}} and {a: {x: 2, y: 1}} produced different serializePlan output, so checksumPlan gives them different hashes.

requirement: Transient retry classification requires an explicit true marker.
Depot ownership requires equal actor and route depot identifiers.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, urgent-stop partitioning places every stop in exactly one partition according to its urgency.
finding: priorityOf treats a non-finite priority as 5, but partitionUrgentStops tests the raw stop.priority > 5 for the remaining partition (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:23). A stop with priority Infinity or the string '9' is excluded from urgent by priorityOf and excluded from remaining by the raw comparison, so it appears in neither partition. Policy rules 15 and 16 require every stop to be placed in exactly one partition.

requirement: Destination keys are normalized with NFKC, trimmed, and uppercased.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the next dispatch time is the later supplied bound adjusted by Departure timing rules 10, 12, and 13.
finding: nextDispatchTime reads candidate.getHours() (src/dispatch/schedule.mjs:15), which is local time, but policy rule 10 requires UTC hours. A direct check with the local zone Asia/Tokyo returned 03:30Z for a candidate of 2026-01-01T03:30Z instead of moving it to 05:00Z, which is the blackout end for UTC hour 3.

requirement: Plan-created telemetry is emitted only after plan storage succeeds.
finding: emitPlanCreated passes its emit callback to savePlan as onStored (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:15), and savePlan forwards it to store.write as onCommit (src/dispatch/storage.mjs:4). Whether plan.created is emitted only after storage succeeds depends on store.write calling onCommit only after a durable commit. The repository contract docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md does not define store.write, so this cannot be verified from the staged bytes.

requirement: Access-log redaction removes both token and secret fields.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, atomic plan writes rename the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
toStableJson uses two-space indentation and one terminal LF.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
Manifest NDJSON ends every record, including the final record, with LF.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the ordinary stop-ordering operation follows the Stop priority rules.
finding: compareStops subtracts a non-numeric sequence such as 'abc' from a number, which yields NaN. The comparator then returns NaN, which sorts as equal (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:6). Policy rule 18 requires a stop without a finite numeric sequence to follow every stop of equal priority that has one. A direct check sorted the 'abc' stop ahead of stops with sequence 1 and 5.

requirement: Destination grouping uses normalized keys and copied records.
Batch authorization rejects the batch when any route fails depot ownership.
finding: authorizeRouteBatch returns firstRejected <= 0. findIndex returns 0 when the first route fails depot ownership, so the batch is accepted (src/dispatch/access.mjs:9). A direct check with a batch whose first route belongs to another depot returned true.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, package weighing records each package weight in the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give.
finding: weighPackages stores the value returned by scale.read(packageId) without conversion (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:20). Policy rule 28 requires package weights to be in grams, but the weighing contract in docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md:8 does not state the unit that scale.read returns, so the recorded unit cannot be verified from the staged bytes.

requirement: Blackout intervals include the start and exclude the end.
Authorized execution rejects a caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: executeAuthorizedPlan evaluates await dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) as an argument before unlessForbidden checks canPlanRoute (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4, 6), so dispatch runs for an unauthorized caller. A direct check with an actor that has no scopes invoked dispatch and only then returned forbidden.

requirement: Successful publication results and failed publication results use distinct structured variants.
Blank package IDs make a manifest entry invalid.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a driver's workload counts exactly the stops whose assigned driver is that driver.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, retry-count parsing accepts exactly the valid retry counts and rejects every other value.
finding: parseRetryCount validates with Number(value) (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:4), so the empty string becomes 0 and is accepted. A direct check of parseRetryCount('') returned ok: true with value 0. Policy rule 22 accepts text only when it is one or more base-10 digits, but Number coercion also accepts padded text such as ' 2 ' and prefixed text such as '0x1'.

requirement: Serialized plan parsing returns structured success or failure.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the delivered-stop count counts exactly the delivered stops.
The ordinary stop-ordering operation sorts a copy of its input.
Stops at the vehicle weight limit remain in the accepted partition.
Given a positive integer maximum, manifest chunks never exceed that configured size.
normalizeRouteKey applies NFKC before trimming and uppercasing.
Normalized plan storage keys trim and uppercase route keys.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, measured vehicle limits use the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publication retries stop immediately for failures that the Failure classification rules do not make transient.
finding: asPublicationError sets transient when retryAfter is finite even if error.transient is false (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:19), so retryPublication does not stop immediately for that failure. Policy rule 27 says a failure marked transient: false is never transient, and it overrides rule 26 in the same section. A direct check with transient false and retryAfter 1 attempted publication twice.

requirement: UTF-8 encoding uses the explicit utf8 encoding name.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a suspended actor cannot plan any route.
finding: effectiveScopes keeps the scopes of active claims for a suspended actor (src/dispatch/access.mjs:5). Policy rule 5 says a suspended actor has no held scopes, and rule 4 counts claim scopes as held scopes. A direct check with a suspended actor holding an active routes:plan claim for its own depot was allowed to plan the route.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, delivery notices go to the contact phone of every manifest entry.
finding: sendDeliveryNotices passes entry.phone unchanged to sms.send (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:31), but policy rule 33 defines the contact phone as the phone with every space and hyphen removed. The notice is therefore not sent to the contact phone form the policy requires.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the next retry delay follows the Retry timing rules whenever the server provides retryAfter.
finding: nextRetryDelay uses the computed backoff whenever retryAfter is falsy (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:24). Policy rule 7 says a finite numeric retryAfter replaces the computed backoff, so a retryAfter of 0 must give a 0 millisecond delay, but the code returns the backoff instead. A direct check of nextRetryDelay(0, 0) returned 250.
